sous_titre: Millions d'adultes de 20 à 79 ans, estimations 2024 et projection 2050

Diabète 2024.texte: the Atlas estimates that 589 million adults aged 20-79 years were living with diabetes in 2024

Dont non diagnostiqué 2024.texte: An estimated 252 million adults are living with undiagnosed diabetes

Intolérance au glucose 2024.texte: 635 million adults age 20-79 (12%) are living with impaired glucose tolerance

Diabète projeté 2050.texte: diabetes cases will increase 45% worldwide to 853 million by 2050
